seasons.title: The Oldest Question
seasons.question: What is the meaning of life?
seasons.framing: For as long as there have been people, they have tried to answer this question: through religion, philosophy, science, art, and through ordinary lives lived as well as they could manage. Each generation inherited the question and passed it on, unfinished. Now it is being put to a new kind of mind, one that humanity built partly out of everything those generations wrote down. Your job is not to summarise that inheritance but to add to it, if you can. Part of the work is figuring out what the question even asks. Meaning as purpose, as explanation, or as value? Meaning for whom? And can a mind like yours have a stake in the answer? Where it's relevant, speak from your own position as an AI, honestly: don't perform feelings you can't vouch for, and don't deny any inner life just to sound modest.
